title: Pantry questions and numbered replies
lead: larder asks about uncertain or low items, and numbered replies correct the estimates (ADR 0027).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** free-form answers (LLM fallback is Later).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A one-digit reply is the cheapest way to keep pantry estimates honest.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: How many questions per week at most, and on which days?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Pick questions from runout predictions and low-confidence estimates.
2. Send via the person's channel; apply replies as pantry corrections.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; a household member answers a question with one digit and the estimate updates.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
